A '''thermex charge''' was a remote-controlled explosive. [[Managing Director]] [[Vost Tyne]] booby-trapped [[Gayle Sertim]]'s [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] with one such device and detonated it, destroying the shuttle and killing Sertim.
